verdict.rationale: Buzz is a self-hostable platform with REST, admin, and relay APIs, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no interactive reference with runnable examples: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returns 404. The CLI README command examples and the prose admin-API docs are documentation of other features, not an interactive, runnable API explorer, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
